19h  ·
September is in full swing with vibrant cultural expos, community gatherings, and pet parades! ☀️ Discover some of the top events happening around Los Angeles this weekend—and one special event on Monday.
5th Annual Deaf Latinos Expo
Sat, September 12, 2026, 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM
📍 Plaza de La Raza, 3540 N. Mission Rd., Los Angeles, CA 90031
💲 Free (RSVP recommended)
East LA Parade & Festival
Sun, September 13, 2026, 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM
📍 E. César E. Chávez Ave. & Mednik Ave., East Los Angeles, CA 90022
💲 Free
Pico Union Pet Parade
Sat, September 12, 2026, 5:00 – 9:00 PM
📍 Alvarado Terrace Park, 1342 S. Alvarado St., Los Angeles, CA 90006
💲 Free
Goodfellas at Cinespia
Sat, September 12, 2026; doors open at 5:45 PM, movie begins at 7:30 PM
📍 Hollywood Forever Cemetery, 6000 Santa Monica Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90038
💲 $31
32nd Annual Festival of Philippine Arts & Culture
Sat, September 12, 2026, 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM
📍 Point Fermin Park, 807 West Paseo Del Mar, San Pedro, CA 90731
💲 Free; RSVP recommended
21st Annual LAWineFest
Sat, September 12, 2026, 2:00 – 6:00 PM & Sun, September 13, 2026, 1:00 – 5:00 PM
📍 Los Angeles Equestrian Center, 480 W. Riverside Drive, Burbank, CA 91506
💲 Ticketed; prices vary
Caribbean Heritage Festival
Sat, September 12, 2026, 2:00 – 7:00 PM
📍 Baldwin Hills Crenshaw Plaza, 3650 W. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd., Los Angeles, CA 90008
💲 Free
Los Ángeles Azules Square Unveiling
Mon, September 14, 2026, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM
📍 Van Nuys Blvd. & Chase St., Panorama City, CA 91402
💲 Free
